summary: PM5: DevHub without plugins; release bundles the core plugins
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub `1188b04`: PM5: DevHub without plugins — plugins/, their tests, TestKit and their docs removed (they live in Naurid/DevHub-Plugins); release.yml bundles Projects, Git, GitHub and Templates from the marketplace index into plugins\ (build/Get-BundledPlugins.ps1 + build/bundled-plugins.json: newest compatible versions plus requirements, SHA-256 and zip-slip checked, all or nothing); a Debug build fetches them once (offline: a message, DevHub starts without them); the shell is checked with tests/DevHub.TestPlugin (tool window + action, in tools/plugin-matrix.ps1); the Sdk zip on releases dropped
- DevHub-Plugins `2a3266c`: PM5: Projects, Git, GitHub and Templates are published (no more "publish": false): tag each <id>/v1 for 1.0.0; DevHub bundles them from the index
